title: Improving semantic equivalence in research-level math formalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.28819v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formalizing mathematics in Lean is never a word-for-word translation of a paper: a Lean formalization changes definitions, strengthens hypotheses, splits arguments, and adds lemmas the paper never mentions. It stands to reason that a model that is good at autoformalization must be a good predictor of how a natural language source must differ from its faithful Lean formalization. With that in mind, we collect 4{,}076 audited examples of such changes from 832 Lean projects that formalize research-level mathematics, and use them to ask a practical question: how well can a model \emph{write} Lean inside a real research-level project that may contain tens of thousands of lines of code, and does training on discrepancies between natural language sources and their faithful Lean formalizations help? Our training set consists of 3{,}431 tasks from 141 repositories, and the test set consists of 645 tasks from the remaining 27 repositories. Trainin

translated_title: 提升研究级数学形式化中的语义等价性
translated_abstract: 在 Lean 中将数学形式化绝非对论文的逐字翻译：Lean 形式化会改变定义、加强假设、拆分论证，并添加论文中从未提及的引理。由此可以推断，一个擅长自动形式化的模型必然也擅长预测自然语言源文本与其忠实的 Lean 形式化之间应当存在的差异。基于这一思路，我们从 832 个形式化研究级数学的 Lean 项目中收集了 4,076 个经过审核的此类修改示例，并借此探讨一个实际问题：模型在包含数万行代码的真实研究级项目中编写 Lean 代码的能力究竟如何？以及在自然语言源文本与其忠实的 Lean 形式化之间的差异上进行训练是否有所帮助？我们的训练集包含来自 141 个代码库的 3,431 个任务，测试集包含来自其余 27 个代码库的 645 个任务。
tldr: 本文从 832 个研究级数学 Lean 形式化项目中收集了 4,076 个自然语言源文本与其 Lean 形式化之间的差异示例，并构建了涵盖 141 个代码库的训练集与 27 个代码库的测试集，用以研究基于此类差异的训练能否提升模型在真实大规模研究级项目中编写语义等价 Lean 代码的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper collects 4,076 audited examples of discrepancies between natural language sources and their faithful Lean formalizations from 832 research-level math projects, and builds training/test sets from 141 and 27 repositories respectively to study whether training on such discrepancies improves a model's ability to write semantically equivalent Lean code in real large-scale research-level projects.
